purpose: Adversarial and boundary fixtures for instrument metadata, context-specific applicability, and evidence-claim scope across life/civic domains. These cases are not legal determinations or empirical impact results.

permitted: check schema shape and expected dispositions
confirm unknown and indeterminate outcomes remain explicit
prohibited: legal advice
compliance certification
official endorsement
current status beyond each recorded source snapshot
production readiness
robot or intervention safety qualification
causal crime-prevention efficacy
universal employment-crime effect
cross-jurisdiction generalization without local evidence
universal industrial-robot-standard applicability to public-facing service robots
robot safety qualification from catalogue membership alone
using national labour-market statistics as a causal crime coefficient without evidence
using national statistics as a local service-area baseline without local data
universal numeric viability thresholds inferred from measurement frameworks
decent-work indicators presented as proof of crime-reduction efficacy
treating police-recorded incidents as a complete census of victimization
using changes in police-report counts alone as causal outcome evidence
transferring national offense-specific reporting proportions to a local service area without validation
mixing incident counts, affected-household counts, and reporting proportions as though they were the same outcome
inferring a causal crime effect from national year-over-year victimization survey changes
transferring national reporting proportions to a Johannesburg intervention without local validation
claiming a year-over-year point-estimate difference is statistically significant without indicator-specific precision evidence
assuming a national survey response rate guarantees equal precision for provincial or subgroup estimates
treating a response rate below a cited quality threshold as proof all estimates from that area are invalid
treating a survey response-rate quality threshold as a statistical-significance threshold or substitute for confidence intervals

frozen_inputs.purpose: structured GPSJS survey-quality and indicator-scope schema

integrity_semantics: git_blob_sha1 binds exact repository object bytes to detect accidental or unreviewed drift. It is a Git object identity, not a signature, source-authenticity proof, or independent collision-resistant trust claim.
